title: Bozeman cattle mutilation with UFO reports

tellings.quote: And there was a cattle mutilation, in which two cows were killed and surgically manipulated.

plain: In 1988 near Bozeman, Montana, two cows were found dead and, in his words, "surgically manipulated," at a time when people there were also reporting UFOs. This is what people call a cattle mutilation: livestock found dead with parts cut away, which some link to UFOs. The physicist Kevin Knuth, presented on the show as a NASA whistleblower, tells it as something he was close to himself.
